description.value: The Cameron Recreation Centre is a City of Burnaby community facility currently operating from temporary premises on the lower level of The City of Lougheed Shopping Centre while its permanent home is demolished and rebuilt. The temporary location offers fitness classes, table tennis, and drop-in PlayZone programming for families. The new permanent facility is planned to better serve northeast Burnaby's growing Lougheed Town Centre population.

The OSM community field says 'North Vancouver' but the facility is clearly in Burnaby (Lougheed Town Centre), and no address or phone is present in the OSM record.
